title: The Return Journey
style: Cinematic painted key art for a modern real-time strategy game, the look of classic Command and Conquer box art: dramatic light, rich colour, crisp detail, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no letters, no flags, no insignia.

music.caption: urgent cinematic underscore, driving low strings and ticking percussion, distant oud and frame drum, a sense of a clock running, warm rising brass at the end, no vocals

shots.prompt: A busy relief warehouse at the edge of a coastal town in Yemen in the morning: pallets of food sacks and water, volunteers loading plain white trucks, dust in shafts of sunlight through the open doors, hopeful but tense.
shots.line: The supplies have reached the coast. Now they must reach the people inland.

shots.prompt: Turn this top-down game map into a glowing holographic tactical map projected on a dark command table, seen at a slight angle. Keep the terrain layout, coastline and roads of the reference. Add a wide pulsing red surveillance sweep zone, a gold dashed convoy route inland and back, small blue truck icons, amber light, a hand holding a pencil at the edge.
shots.line: A surveillance sweep is closing on the corridor. Anything still inside the zone when it arrives will be found.

shots.prompt: A wide valley road seen from a hilltop at midday, a fan of scanning red light from distant radar masts sweeping across a dry riverbed, a small convoy of trucks raising dust below, ominous clouds.
shots.line: Get your mobile force out early, and keep a reserve on the road home.

shots.prompt: Portrait of a fictional Yemeni army captain in his thirties, short black beard, olive field uniform and a scarf around the neck, radio handset in hand, standing beside a dusty pickup truck on an empty desert roadside under a clear sky, nothing else in the background, focused and resolute, looking at the viewer, cinematic rim light, painted portrait.
shots.line: Commander. Protect the deliveries, then bring the evacuation convoy home.

shots.prompt: An evacuation convoy of buses and white trucks moving down a mountain road at golden hour, families as small silhouettes at the windows, escort vehicles at the front and back, long shadows, determined mood.
shots.line: Every vehicle that comes back is a family that made it out.

shots.prompt: The coast road at dusk seen from behind the last truck of a convoy, tail lights glowing, the sea and the lights of the port ahead, calm after danger.
